access.loginHint: You sign in before it searches

linkedinRisk.title: Let the agent browse LinkedIn?
linkedinRisk.p1: LinkedIn's terms forbid browsing its website with automated tools. Even though the agent uses your browser, goes slowly and only reads, LinkedIn may restrict or close your account if it detects it.
linkedinRisk.p2: Its email alerts (“Email alerts”, on this same page) and the “Send to CandidatAI” button while you view a job bring in its jobs without browsing LinkedIn automatically.
linkedinRisk.p3: You can turn it off whenever you like. You always send applications yourself.
linkedinRisk.activate: Turn on at my own risk

publicRisk.detail: Besides the results list, the app will request the public page of each new job that passes your filters (with a cap per run). That is more requests to LinkedIn and therefore a higher chance it blocks your IP. Without this, jobs come in as summaries and you complete them with the “Send to CandidatAI” button.
publicRisk.p1: Once a day the app will query LinkedIn's public search (the one people see when not signed in) with this card's searches. It does not use your account or your cookies, goes slowly and identifies itself honestly.
publicRisk.p2: Even so, LinkedIn's terms forbid automated access, and LinkedIn may block your IP for a while (for normal browsing too). If it does, the app stops immediately and does not try again for a few days.
publicRisk.p3: It is for personal use. Email alerts and the “Send to CandidatAI” button bring in jobs without querying LinkedIn automatically. You always send applications yourself.
publicRisk.download: Download it at my own risk
publicRisk.activate: Turn on at my own risk

public.label: LinkedIn public search
public.title: Public search without signing in
public.intro: Different from “The agent browses it”: once a day the app queries LinkedIn's public search, without your account, with the searches above. New jobs that pass your filters come in as summaries in the Job inbox.
public.switch: LinkedIn public search without signing in
public.detailHint: Up to {{offers}} per run; the more requests, the likelier LinkedIn is to block your connection
public.noSearch: No search can be used: add to this platform a LinkedIn Jobs search with keywords or a location (copy the address of the results page).
public.blocked: LinkedIn cut off the last search (request limit, sign-in or captcha). It will not try again until {{date}}.
public.daily: Once a day: the next one from {{date}}

row.notRun: The agent has not browsed it yet
row.invalid: Its settings are not valid. Ask your agent to set it up again (“set up my job search platforms”).
row.priorityHint: The order in which your agent goes through the job boards when you ask it to search for jobs: number 1 first, then 2… Each place belongs to one platform only: if you pick a taken one, the two swap.
row.accessHint: How the agent gets in. Open: without signing in. Signed in: you need to be signed in to your browser yourself (it never types your password). Blocked: the agent skips it.
row.maxOffersHint: The maximum number of new jobs the agent adds each time it goes through this job board. Lower it if you get too many to review.
row.problemsHint: What stopped part of the job board being read: a captcha, a login, a page that has changed.
row.notesHint: Nothing failed: this is what it wrote down, like the searches it did not get to.

limits: App limits: at most {{pages}} of results per search (it stops earlier when it reaches what the previous search saw), {{delay}} s pause between pages and {{offers}} new jobs per run on new platforms (the ones you already have do not count); change it on each one with “Jobs per run”.

empty.title: You are not searching any job board yet
empty.body: Ask your agent to set it up: it asks where you search, recommends job boards and prepares their searches with the roles in your profile. Or add one yourself: on known job boards, the searches come from your profile.

title: Job boards
intro: Your agent goes through them in this order when you search.

add.linkedinTitle: It is saved with searching turned off, which is the recommended setting.
add.linkedinP1: LinkedIn's terms forbid browsing its website with automated tools, and it may restrict or close your account if it detects it, even if the agent uses your browser and only reads. The safe way is to get its jobs through email alerts (“Where to search → Email alerts”) or with the “Send to CandidatAI” button.
add.linkedinP2: If you still want the agent to browse it, turn it on afterwards with its switch, at your own risk.
add.title: Add job board
add.description: A job board where your agent searches for jobs with your browser when you press “Search jobs”.
add.name: Name
add.urlsHint: Run the search on the job board (role, location, filters) and copy the results address here, one per line.
add.urlsHintGenerated: They come from the roles and locations in your profile (you change them in “Search jobs”). You can remove or add lines: one address per search.
add.urlsHintNoRoles: Add the roles you are looking for in “Search jobs” and they fill in by themselves. Or run the search on the job board and paste the results address here.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.description: Change the name or the searches. The order, the access and whether your agent browses it are changed in its row.
